findings.evidence: `layerActivation_of_lt` (Basic.lean:95) returns `A.activation ⟨i.val, _⟩`, while the right-hand sides are `C.lowerLayers.activation i` (a `Fin.take`) or `C.junctionActivation`; only `rfl` connects them.
findings.fix: Rewrite with `lowerLayers_activation`/`upperLayers_activation`/`junctionActivation_def` and close the index goal with `congrArg C.activation (Fin.ext rfl)` or `simp [Fin.ext_iff]`.
findings.issue: `layerActivation_castAdd_castSucc`, `layerActivation_castAdd_last` (line 123) and `layerActivation_natAdd` (line 132) end `rw [...]` with an uncommented `rfl` that only works by unfolding `Fin.take`/`Fin.castLE`/`Fin.natAdd`/`junctionActivation`.

findings.evidence: `h : Fin.snoc C.lowerLayers.activation C.junctionActivation = …` is proved by `Fin.snoc_init_self (q := …)`, whose statement is about `Fin.init q` and `q (Fin.last L)`.
findings.fix: Add bridge lemmas such as `lowerLayers_activation_eq_init` or rewrite with `Fin.take_apply` first; otherwise add a comment naming the definitional equality being used.
findings.issue: `append_lowerLayers_upperLayers` checks `h` by matching `Fin.snoc_init_self` against `C.lowerLayers.activation` (a `Fin.take`). `lowerLayers_append` (line 352) applies `Fin.append_left` to goals stated through `Fin.take`/`castLE`. Both work only because `take`/`init` and `castLE`/`castAdd` agree definitionally, and no comment says so.

findings.evidence: The proof bodies at lines 302–306 and 317–323 differ only in `splitParameters`/`splitWeights` and `realize`/`realizeWeights`.
findings.fix: Factor out a general lemma: for `e : P ≃ P₁ × P₂` with `F (e.symm (a, b)) = g ∘ h ∘ f`, `realizedFunctions F = Set.image2 …`. Derive both theorems from it, or prove each in tactic mode with `ext; simp [Set.mem_image2]`.
findings.issue: `realizedFunctions_realize` and `realizedFunctions_realizeWeights` (line 311) copy the same five-step chain of named lemmas (`range_comp`, `congrArg`, `image2_range`, `congrArg₂`), which is brittle under Mathlib renames.

summary: Several proofs close index and activation goals with bare `rfl` or term matching that only work through undocumented definitional equality of `Fin.take`/`castLE`/`natAdd`/`Fin.init`. The two `realizedFunctions_*` theorems copy the same brittle five-step chain of named lemmas.
